stories.text: As a visitor, I want visible active places within 100 m sorted by distance or in a map area, so that I can choose where to visit.
As a visitor, I want to listen to a place's narration in my chosen language, so that I understand its story without a guide.
As a visitor, I want English or Vietnamese fallback when my language is not ready, so that I can still use available narration.
As a visitor, I want to choose one of five languages and have it remembered, so that I do not pick it every time.
As a visitor, I want a missing language prepared and a choice to switch while listening, so that I control when playback changes.
As a visitor, I want to simulate my location at a demo spot, so that I can try the app without being on site.
As the project owner, I want image credits shown next to every image, so that we respect the Wikimedia licences.
As a visitor, I want to install the app on my home screen, so that it opens like a native app.
As a staff member, I want to sign in and access functions permitted by my roles, so that administrative actions are protected.
As a content editor, I want to add, edit, archive, hide/show and restore places, so that I control the public place list.
As a content editor, I want to publish a Vietnamese draft and prepare text and audio for all five languages, so that content production is automated.
As a content editor, I want place names kept correct in every language, so that translation never mangles a landmark's name.
As a content editor, I want to follow the progress of all nine jobs after publishing, so that I know when the new version is live.
As a content editor, I want the previous version served until the new Vietnamese text and audio are ready, so that visitors keep receiving usable narration.
As an operator, I want to filter jobs by status, so that I spot failures quickly.
As an operator, I want to request another generation attempt for a failed language, so that I can recover it without republishing.
As the project owner, I want repeated messages to reuse stored translations and audio, so that completed work is not generated again.
As the project owner, I want one failing language not to block the others, so that most content still ships.
As a developer, I want CI to build and test affected services and apps on pull requests, so that relevant changes are validated before merging.
As a developer, I want merges to main to build and deploy affected backend services independently, so that unrelated services keep running.
As a developer, I want to trace one message across all services, so that I can debug the pipeline.
As a staff member, I want overall and per-place visitor and listening statistics for a selected period, so that I can assess application usage.
As a staff member, I want to export statistics to Excel for a chosen scope and date range, so that I can save or share the report.

businessRules.text: The nearby list uses a 100 m radius. Map discovery uses the selected map area.
Visitors see only active, visible, non-deleted POIs. A new POI becomes active once its Vietnamese text and audio are ready.
The system supports VI, EN, JA, KO and ZH. Source content is Vietnamese.
Publishing queues translations and audio for all five languages in the background.
Narration fallback order is the chosen language, then English, then Vietnamese.
A narration version and language may have only one generation request in progress.
Missing-language status is checked every 2 seconds for at most 30 seconds. Active playback is switched only with visitor consent.
Only a complete saved Draft can be published. A new draft receives the next version number; publishing uses that version.
The previous version serves until the new version has Vietnamese text and audio. Other languages may temporarily use fallback.
Delete archives a POI and retains its content. Restoring a POI with a live version makes it Hidden; others return to Draft.
After applicable retries, a failed language is marked Failed without discarding successful languages. An Operator may request another attempt.
Only Content Editors maintain POIs and publish narration. Only Operators regenerate jobs. Both roles may view statistics and export reports.
Visitor totals count each visitor identifier once per selected scope and period.
Report dates use UTC+7. Online counts and place status are current snapshots at viewing or export time.
Listening statistics use actual audio playback and its language; pause/resume does not add a listen.
Export dates include both endpoints, must be ordered, end no later than today, and lie within the last 25 months.

fields.Summary: Confirm a staff session or sign in.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. Operator-only account: open Synthesis Jobs and end. / A2. Reuse an existing or renewed valid session and return to the calling use case without signing in again.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. Invalid sign-in / temporary lock: show error; retry step 1. / E2. Inactive account / no active staff role: refuse access and end. / E3. Other failures: show a service error; retry step 1.
fields.Triggers: The actor wishes to access Admin Web.
fields.Preconditions: The actor has a staff account.
fields.Post Conditions: A valid staff session and permitted access are available.

flow: 1. The actor enters a username or email and password.
2. The system validates the credentials. E1, E3
3. The system checks the account status and active staff roles. E2
4. The system creates an authenticated session.
5. The system opens Places with permitted functions. A1 End.

fields.Summary: A visitor discovers nearby places in a list or on the map.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. Open the map and search the selected map area instead. Continue at step 4. / A2. If no place is found, show an empty state. The visitor may explore another map area.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. If location is denied or unavailable, show guidance and Retry. Return to step 2. / E2. If loading fails, show an error and Retry. Return to step 3.
fields.Triggers: The visitor wishes to discover places.
fields.Assumptions: The device has location services and internet access.
fields.Post Conditions: Available places or an empty state are displayed.

flow: 1. The visitor opens nearby discovery. A1
2. The system obtains the device location. E1
3. The system finds visible active POIs within 100 m, sorted by distance. E2
4. The system displays the places. A2
5. The visitor views or selects a place. The use case ends.

fields.Summary: A visitor listens in the chosen language or an available fallback.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. If the chosen language is unavailable, use English when ready; otherwise use Vietnamese. Continue at step 4. / A2. At Fallback version, UC4 extends this use case when is_fallback = true. / A3. Play from a place card starts playback after loading. Continue at step 6.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. If retrieval fails, show an error; retry step 3. / E2. If playback fails, show an error; retry Play.
fields.Extension Points: Fallback version: at step 4, perform UC4 if is_fallback = true.
fields.Triggers: The visitor wishes to hear about a place.
fields.Assumptions: The device can play MP3 audio.
fields.Preconditions: The selected place is visible and active.
fields.Post Conditions: Narration plays in the chosen or fallback language.

flow: 1. The visitor opens a place from the list or map.
2. The visitor chooses a language.
3. The system retrieves the narration. A1, A2, E1
4. The system displays text and playback controls. A2
5. The visitor selects Play. A3
6. The system plays the audio. E2 The use case ends.

fields.Summary: The system prepares a missing narration language.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. Reuse an existing request for this narration version and language. Continue at step 4. / A2. During playback, offer Switch. Accepting restarts in the new language; otherwise keep fallback.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. Failure or 30 s timeout: keep fallback; offer Retry. / E2. Request failure or rate limit: keep fallback and stop waiting.
fields.Assumptions: Translation and TTS services are reachable.
fields.Post Conditions: Requested language is ready, or fallback is retained.

flow: 1. The visitor reads or listens to the fallback.
2. The system requests the chosen language. A1, E2
3. The system generates text and audio in the background.
4. The system checks the status every 2 seconds. E1
5. Show the requested language for next Play. A2 The use case ends.

fields.Summary: An editor adds, edits, archives, hides, shows or restores places.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. Confirm Delete to archive a place and retain its content. Continue at step 6. / A2. Confirm Hide/Show or Restore. Restore returns Hidden with a live version, otherwise Draft. Continue at step 6. / A3. Cancel a pending action without changes. Return to step 3.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. Invalid data: show validation errors; return to step 4. / E2. Save/action failure: show an error. Reload changed records before retrying.
fields.Triggers: The editor wishes to maintain places.
fields.Preconditions: The actor has the Content Editor role.
fields.Post Conditions: The selected changes are saved; archived or hidden places are not public.

flow: 1. Perform {Authenticate User}.
2. The editor opens Places.
3. The system displays the filtered POI list. A1, A2, A3
4. The editor enters name, category and coordinates, directly or on the map.
5. The system validates and saves the POI. E1, E2
6. The system updates the list. New places remain Draft until activation. The use case ends.

fields.Actor (s): Content Editor, Translation Service, TTS Service
fields.Summary: An editor publishes a draft for background generation.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. Failed languages retain successful results. An Operator may regenerate them; activation follows BR 2.9.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. Invalid draft: correct it and return to step 2. / E2. Publish/progress error: show an error; reload or retry.
fields.Triggers: The editor has finished a Vietnamese narration.
fields.Assumptions: The Vietnamese content has been reviewed.
fields.Preconditions: The actor is a Content Editor with a saved Draft.
fields.Post Conditions: The version is queued; activation follows BR 2.9.

flow: 1. Perform {Authenticate User}.
2. Save and review the draft.
3. The editor selects Publish.
4. The system validates the draft. E1, E2
5. Queue generation atomically; confirm and show progress every 2 s.
6. Translate EN/JA/KO/ZH and generate audio for all five languages. A1
7. Activate when VI text/audio are ready; retain visibility. End.

fields.Summary: An operator monitors synthesis jobs and requests regeneration of failed jobs.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. If no failed job needs handling, the use case ends. / A2. Without regenerating, return to step 4.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. Loading failure: show an error; retry step 3. / E2. Regeneration failure: show an error; retry or return to the list.
fields.Triggers: The operator wishes to check jobs or handle a failure.
fields.Preconditions: The actor has the Operator role.
fields.Post Conditions: Accepted regeneration requests are queued for background processing.

flow: 1. Perform {Authenticate User}.
2. The operator opens Synthesis Jobs.
3. The system refreshes the job list every 2 seconds. E1
4. The operator filters jobs or changes page. A1
5. The operator opens a failed job.
6. The system displays the error and attempt details.
7. The operator selects Regenerate. A2
8. The system queues another attempt and refreshes the list. E2 Return to step 3.

fields.Summary: Staff view overall or per-place visitor and listening statistics.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. The actor selects a place. The system displays its statistics. Return to step 4. / A2. If no data is available, the system shows an empty state or no-data marker. Return to step 4.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. If loading fails, the system shows an error and offers retry. Retry returns to step 3; otherwise the use case ends.
fields.Extension Points: Report displayed: UC9 extends UC8 when Export data is selected.
fields.Triggers: The actor wishes to assess application or place usage.
fields.Assumptions: The device has an internet connection.
fields.Preconditions: The actor has the Content Editor or Operator role.

flow: 1. Perform {Authenticate User}.
2. The actor opens Overview or Place Statistics.
3. The system displays the last 7 days, including today. A2, E1
4. The actor selects Today, 7 days or 30 days, or inspects the report. A1
5. The system shows the requested metrics, charts or calendar details.
6. The actor finishes viewing. The use case ends.

fields.Summary: Staff export usage statistics to Excel for storage or sharing.
fields.Alternative Paths: A1. Export from a place list or detail uses that scope. Continue at step 3. / A2. Before exporting, the actor cancels. The use case ends.
fields.Exception Paths: E1. Invalid dates disable export. Correct the dates at step 4. / E2. If export fails, the system shows an error. Retry at step 6 or cancel.
fields.Triggers: The actor wishes to save or share usage statistics.
fields.Preconditions: Staff role and a loaded statistics view are required.
fields.Post Conditions: An Excel report for the selected scope and dates is downloaded.

flow: 1. Perform {Authenticate User}.
2. The actor opens Export data from Overview. A1
3. The system displays the scope and date fields. A2
4. The actor selects the start and end dates.
5. The system validates the date range. E1
6. The actor selects Export Excel. A2
7. The system downloads the Excel report. E2 The use case ends.
